question: Under what condition does poison fail to enter the body?
premises: A person may be bitten by great serpents.
Even if bitten, poison does not enter the body.
inference: In the stated condition, poison fails to enter the body even if the person has been bitten by great serpents.
uncertainties: The condition that prevents poison from entering is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
